description: Is this domain, URL or sender domain safe to trust, pay or onboard: malware URL and host lists (URLhaus), hijacked netblocks (Spamhaus DROP), botnet C2 and active-threat IPs behind it, disposable e-mail domains, domain age and registrar from RDAP, MX / SPF / DMARC posture (for an e-mail address: can it receive mail, can it be spoofed), hosting country against the FATF, EU, FinCEN 311 and OFAC lists. Returns allow / review / block with reasons. Use for vendor onboarding, payment-instruction and bank-detail change requests, invoice fraud and phishing triage.
name: screen_domain
title: Screen domain / URL / e-mail domain
